name: Identity and source history
meaning: A real/logical thing is distinct from the source rows and representations describing it

name: Project and place
meaning: Recognizable locations; overlapping zones and multi-storey objects remain possible

name: Coordinates and representations
meaning: Position/orientation, parent frames, 2D/3D shape and selectable detail

name: Building fabric
meaning: Common components with useful typed fields and spatial/contextual links

name: Structure and civil
meaning: Structural and site objects; linear and surface features as well as solids

name: Interiors and landscape
meaning: Surfaces and assemblies that trades measure and specify

name: Systems and equipment
meaning: Connectivity, membership, flow/medium and service relationships are distinct

name: Materials and measurement
meaning: Material contributions and quantities with explicit basis and provenance

name: Commercial and delivery
meaning: A work item can concern multiple objects and may have no independent geometry

name: Operations and performance
meaning: Stable assets plus links to operational records and scenario results

name: Environment and assessment
meaning: Versioned factors/rules and explainable results with incomplete/unknown outcomes

name: Flexible evidence
meaning: Preserve source detail and explain how curated values were chosen
